title: Excavations in Palestine in 1931-2: Jerusalem, American School of Oriental Research
author: (round-up; clearance by M. Burrows)
location_note: Garden of the American School of Oriental Research, Jerusalem; placed by name.
notes: April 1932: built, plastered, barrel-vaulted tomb complex of three rooms divided into compartments, bones of about one hundred bodies, glass, inscribed lamp; coins of Anastasius I; earlier coins (procurators to Julian) outside the walls.

features.subtype: built, plastered tomb complex of three compartmented rooms (charnel burials)
features.period: near the beginning of the sixth century AD (finds; coins of Anastasius I)
features.quote: a tomb-complex was discovered in the garden of the American School
